question: Which deities are invoked to protect the feet and all the limbs?
premises: Mahāmāyā is invoked for the pair of feet
Kuleśvarī is invoked for all limbs
Protection covers specific and general body parts
inference: Mahāmāyā protects the feet and Kuleśvarī protects all limbs.
plain_english: May Mahāmāyā protect my pair of feet, and may Kuleśvarī protect all my limbs.
